claims.claim: Committed only the three authorized new diagnostic files, adding a no-argument command that rejects unsupported arguments before experimentation and preserves existing diagnostics, fixtures and production behavior.
The primitive binds exactly four independently materialized real-Git cases crossing both canonical full-identity ref families with root lengths 224 and 228, without retry or expansion.

Each case validates its resolved remote-root geometry immediately before one checked PUSH, reports derived lock length, performs real update-ref, checks repository-local longpaths on both repositories, and verifies successful full-ref resolution through show-ref and ls-remote.
Closed output schemas retain only bounded typed facts and allowlisted stderr categories and sorted signatures; raw Git operands, process output and exception details remain private.

Relationships contain only per-family outcome vectors, first failed root lengths and same-root agreement; subject, geometry, case-set, resolution, schema and instrumentation failures fail closed without selecting a cause or correction.

Added regression coverage for argument rejection, fixed binding, exact and derived geometry, real checked-PUSH success and failure, relationships, every stderr category/signature path, privacy, subject mutation, and malformed, missing or duplicate cases.
Regression tests use protocol fixtures, geometry checks and short disposable real-Git transport cases; this execution performed no live 224/228 experiment or TASK-231 continuation.
